info.title: Infrastructure Lifecycle Management API
info.description: Outbound agent infrastructure lifecycle API. Phase 4 adds immutable campaign snapshots, four staged rollouts, independent approvals, explicit IANA maintenance windows, shared concurrency reservations, bounded retries, safety pause gates and signed cancellation. Only ValidateOnly and DrainAndVerify are executable. Operators create/start/pause/cancel campaigns; approvers approve/reject and acknowledge safety resumes. Administrators manage org limits and memberships. All organization reads require membership. Bootstrap bearer is restricted to isolated local development.

bootstrapBearer.description: Generated development-only global admin token; minimum 32 characters.

oidcBearer.description: OIDC ID token from the configured issuer and audience. Subject membership is looked up in PostgreSQL.
